extra_control_recipe: No data-dependent loads, same recurrence/timer, analyzed separately; not a third memory-load stratum.
region_model: 64 contiguous non-overlapping virtual windows covering each 0.25/1/4 L2-sized pool span; fixed same logical chains across SMs and rounds; no physical-page claim.
cache_pressure_definition: Allocation span, exact sampled unique words and 32B/128B address spans reported separately. No claim that the entire allocation is read or resident during the consumer.
sample_order: Case order randomized within chronological rounds; region permutation changes each round; block-ID hash selects cyclic start, never interpreted as SM assignment. Reference region interleaved.
concurrency: 32-thread CTA; one or 32 active dependent chains. Dense grid=2 or 4 times SM count; denser-access grid=16 times SM count. Neither is contention-free latency.
affinity_model: Per-dispatch log cycles/step corrected by categorical SM, region, slot and block-wave effects using alternating weighted demeaning; observed-cell residuals only. SM clustering is fit on first 32 regions of development allocations. No missing-cell imputation.
assignment: Balanced region-to-group selection from early rounds; later-round comparison to a cyclic group-label permutation preserving group task counts. New-region home requires its own early-round measurements.
selection: Select one K/condition using mean later-round development benefit minus twice its across-allocation standard deviation; require positive independent confirmation in both heldout allocations and >=3% mean, above arithmetic-control noise. K=1 is null. No significance claim from individual loads.
transfer: Stale old-region assignment evaluated only against new owned allocations; no old pointer reuse.
